$comment: Durable task ledger. state/nextAction are updated by `npm run context:handoff`; history records every change with its evidence.

records.title: Implement the context continuity system
records.objective: Give any authorised agent — any model, client or context size — a governed, verifiable path to recover the project's knowledge, continue work and hand off, with preserved evidence and measurable coverage.
scope: PROJECT-CONTEXT/ (schemas, knowledge, generated views, packs, task packs, handoffs, receipts, verification)
exclusions: No change to the marketplace/product runtime (lib/*.js outside lib/context, server.js, public/)
No change to _registry/*.json or the constitutional projections
Pre-existing defects (ISS-CANONICAL-INPUT-MISNAMED, ISS-REVIEW-FINDINGS-UNRECONCILED) are tracked, not fixed here
No push, PR or deployment without owner authorisation
acceptance: npm run context:verify exits 0 on the committed tree
node test/context.js passes (determinism, invalidation, hygiene safety, restore, fresh-agent scenario)
npm run context:assimilate -- TASK-CTX-0001 passes on the committed tree
the pre-existing npm test and npm run registry results are unchanged by this work
a schema-valid handoff records the outcome
records.nextAction: Finish the implementation, run the verification commands, record the outcome with `npm run context:handoff`.

records.title: Owner review of the continuity design decisions
records.objective: Have the owner approve, amend or reject each DEC-CTX-* decision so the continuity system's design is owner-approved, not agent-proposed.
scope: any follow-up changes the owner asks for
exclusions: No change to approved constitutional decisions
acceptance: each DEC-CTX-* has status approved, superseded or reversed, with the owner as authority and a date
records.nextAction: Owner reads PROJECT-CONTEXT/03-DECISION-REGISTER.md and states a verdict per decision.

records.title: Archive the 2026-10-22 session transcript
records.objective: Preserve the owner's master prompt as original evidence in access-controlled storage so REQ-CTX-* can be checked against it.
scope: re-cite REQ-CTX-* to the imported source segments
exclusions: The transcript bytes are never committed to git
acceptance: a 'store' source exists with sensitivity private and a verified sha256
records.nextAction: Owner exports the transcript and provides an access-controlled CONTEXT_ARCHIVE_DIR.

records.title: Correct the seal's misnamed zero-hardcoding input
records.objective: Make the canonical seal hash the zero-hardcoding constitution the compiler actually parses.
exclusions: No change to the constitution's content
acceptance: npm run registry passes with no missing input
an edit to UCRS-Zero-Hardcoding-Constitution.md drifts the seal
records.nextAction: Confirm the intended file with the owner, then change lib/canonical.js:104 and re-run the registry checks.

records.title: Reconcile REVIEW.md findings with their fixes
records.objective: Record, for each finding in REVIEW.md (2026-10-12), whether it is fixed, by which commit, and which test proves it.
acceptance: every finding has fixed/open status with commit + test evidence
records.nextAction: Map each REVIEW.md finding to the commits of PR #1/#2 and the tests in test/security.js.
